claims.text: General availability is not promised: payment-retry is limited to the controlled pilot and GA is not approved, with no general release date confirmed. A partner should not tell customers it launches until a general release date is confirmed.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.

claims.text: The externally shared material partners can use is the shared payment-retry capability page, which covers pilot limits; externally it provides no launch date or GA promise.

supports.quote: External partners can consult the shared payment-retry capability page for pilot limits.
